note: City of Morden recreation programs, which the pembinavalleyonline/gwevents crawlers do not carry. Fixed-date entries use 'date'; recurring programs use 'weekdays' (Mon=0 .. Sun=6) and get the next occurrence computed at merge time, so an ongoing weekly program never drops off the site once its representative date passes.

events.title: GROW PD Day Camp
events.time: 9:00 AM–4:00 PM · Access Event Centre, Morden
events.description: City of Morden and Big Brothers Big Sisters — a fun, interactive day for girls in Grades 5 & 6. Confidence, leadership, healthy living. FREE.

events.title: Wreath Making Workshop
events.time: 6:30–8:00 PM · Access Event Centre – MCC Room, Morden
events.description: Get into the holiday spirit with Earth Buds Florist and create your own holiday wreath to take home. $77.50 per participant, all supplies and instruction included.

events.title: Intro to Freestyle Wrestling
events.description: Boys and girls ages 9–12, all experience levels welcome. Runs Dec 2, 9 & 16 and Jan 6 & 13. $25 for 5 sessions. Coach David Langill.

events.title: Red Cross Babysitting Course
events.time: Fri Jan 29 6–9 PM & Sat Jan 30 5–9 PM · Morden
events.description: Canadian Red Cross Babysitting Course for youth ages 11–15. First aid, safety and caregiving essentials. $65.

events.title: Table Tennis
events.time: Wednesdays 7–9 PM · Access Event Centre, Morden
events.description: Casual recreational table tennis, all ages and skill levels. Season runs October 2026 – April 2027. No instruction. Reduced season rate or $3 drop-in.

events.title: 12+ Basketball
events.time: Wednesdays 9–10 PM (Oct–Nov), 8–10 PM (Dec–June) · École Morden Middle School
events.description: Drop-in basketball for ages 12+. Reduced season rate or $3 drop-in.

events.title: 16+ Co-ed Volleyball
events.time: Tuesdays 8:00–10:00 PM · École Morden Middle School
events.description: Co-ed volleyball, all skill levels welcome. Season runs October 2026 – May 2027. Reduced season rate or $3 drop-in.

events.title: Youth Pickleball
events.time: Tuesdays 5:30–7:00 PM · Access Event Centre Community Hall, Morden
events.description: Teens in Grades 7–12. Runs Oct 6 – Apr 13. All skill levels welcome, no experience necessary. Reduced season rate or $5 drop-in.

events.title: Pickleball
events.time: Sun 6:00–9:00 PM, Mon 8:30–11:30 AM, Tue 8:30–11:30 AM & 7:00–10:00 PM · Access Event Centre Community Hall, Morden
events.description: Weekly drop-in pickleball, beginner to experienced. $3 per player per session or a reduced seasonal rate. Check the schedule — some sessions are cancelled for special events and facility bookings.

events.title: Free Public Skating
events.time: Sundays 12:15–1:45 PM · Access Event Centre, Morden
events.description: Free public skating — bring the family. Skate lending available in a limited range of sizes. Full schedule at morden.ca/public-skating.

events.title: Ice Programs
events.description: 55+ Skate & Stick & Puck (FREE), Parent & Tot (FREE), Morning Skate ($5), Stick & Puck ($5), Homeschool Skate & Stick & Puck ($2.50), Public Skating (FREE). See morden.ca/rec-programs for days and times.
